(
	i/process
	i/fs
	i/core
	i/stdio
	i/bit_array
	i/json
	i/string
	i/int
)

parse_amount = (value) {
	value |> (json.Text(text)) {
		digit = (c) {
			n = core.codepoint_to_int(c)
			n >= 48 && n <= 57
		}
		unsigned = string.remove_prefix(string.remove_prefix(text, "+"), "-")
		valid = unsigned != "" && list.all(core.codepoints(unsigned), digit)
		valid |> (True()) {
			int.parse(text) |>
				(Ok(n)) {
					{ n >= 0 && n <= 1000 } |>
						(True()) { Some(n) }
						& (False()) { None() }
				}
				& (Error(_)) { None() }
		}
		& (False()) { None() }
	}
	& (_) { None() }
}

process_record = (line, balance) {
	json.parse(line) |>
		(Ok(json.Object(fields))) {
			list.key_find(fields, "op") |>
				(Some(json.Text("reset"))) { (True(), balance) }
				& (Some(json.Text("credit"))) {
					list.key_find(fields, "amount") |> parse_amount |>
						(Some(amount)) { (True(), balance + amount) }
						& (_) { (False(), balance) }
				}
				& (Some(json.Text("debit"))) {
					list.key_find(fields, "amount") |> parse_amount |>
						(Some(amount) ? balance >= amount) {
							(True(), balance - amount)
						}
						& (_) { (False(), balance) }
				}
				& (_) { (False(), balance) }
		}
		& (_) { (False(), balance) }
}

walk = (lines, balance, errors, output) {
	lines |> ([]) {
		(output, balance, errors)
	}
	& ([line, ..rest]) {
		(success, next) = process_record(line, balance)
		state =
			success
				|> (True()) {
					(output <> "OK " <> int.to_string(next) <> "\n", next, errors)
				}
				& (False()) {
					(
						output <> "ERROR " <> int.to_string(balance) <> "\n",
						balance,
						errors + 1,
					)
				}
		walk(rest, state.1, state.2, state.0)
	}
}

main = () {
	args = process.args()
	args |> ([path]) {
		fail.catch(() { fs.read_file(path) }) |>
			(Ok(bytes)) {
				bit_array.to_string(bytes) |>
					(Ok(text)) {
						lines =
							{ text == "" } |> (True()) { [] } & (False()) {
								parts = string.split(text, "\n")
								{ string.ends_with(text, "\n") } |>
									(True()) {
										list.take(parts, list.length(parts) - 1)
									}
									& (False()) { parts }
							}
						(output, balance, errors) = walk(lines, 0, 0, "")
						stdio.write(<<output:utf8>>)
						stdio.print(
							"TOTAL " <> int.to_string(balance) <> " ERRORS " <>
								int.to_string(errors),
						)
					}
					& (_) { stdio.print("ERROR INPUT") }
			}
			& (_) { stdio.print("ERROR INPUT") }
	}
	& (_) { stdio.print("ERROR INPUT") }
}
